newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA SHARES STEADY, DE BEERS SLIPS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA SHARES STEADY, DE BEERS SLIPS.

text.p: 1308 GMT - South African shares steady in afternoon trade as market continue uninspired by a better-than-expected June PPI figure, while diamonds firm De Beers slides after higher tax knocks bottom-line earnings.
* Tax payable by De Beers and its international arm De Beers Centenary AG was $156 million in the interim period compared to $105 million in the same period last year.
* De Beers' stock last down 400 cents at 167.00 rand as gold shares hold afternoon levels on a static bullion price.
* Dealers see market ending at current levels unless Wall Street kicks up significantly at start.
* Chemicals firm Sentrachem adds 40 cents to new year high of 10.65, as jobbers pour in on stock on expectations Dow Chemicals Co could better its buy offer after firm rejected initial one.
* All-shares up 15.1 points to 7,598.2, industrials gain 35.1 points to 9,274.5 and golds gain 3.4 points to 1,019.7.
